tasks.title: Conversation #16
tasks.transcript:
MAN: Hello. This is Jerod Townshend calling from Arbor Rental Car. May I speak with Ms. Murray, please?
WOMAN: This is she. Are you calling about the car I booked online this morning?
MAN: That's correct, Ms. Murray. Unfortunately, we've been having problems with our computer system all day, so your reservation was only partially saved. I therefore have to confirm some information. You need a car starting on the tenth of this month, right?
WOMAN: That's correct. And I requested an SUV.
MAN: Oh, I'm really glad I called you...Let me write that down.
WOMAN: Sure. Is there anything else you'd like to know?

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the call?
questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问这通电话的目的，属于主旨/目的理解题，需抓住男士打电话的核心原因。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 男士明确说“your reservation was only partially saved. I therefore have to confirm some information”，说明他打电话的目的是确认并获取正确的预订信息。 选项B：错误。 男士在电话中并未道歉，只是解释系统出了问题，属于无中生有。 选项C：错误。 对话讨论的是租车预订，而非航班时间，属于与原文无关的干扰项。 选项D：错误。 男士没有提供任何特别优惠，只是在核实预订信息。

questions.stem: What does the man imply when he says, “Oh, I'm really glad I called you”?

options.C: The woman's booking was not saved.
options.D: No cars are available on the tenth.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问男士说“Oh, I'm really glad I called you”时暗示了什么，属于推理判断题，需结合上下文理解他为什么感到庆幸。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 对话中完全没有提到女士的地址变更，属于无中生有。 选项B：正确。 男士之前说预订信息只被部分保存（partially saved），他打电话核实时发现女士需要的是SUV，说明这一信息没有被正确记录。他庆幸自己打了电话，否则就会弄错。 选项C：错误。 男士说的是预订信息被“部分保存”，而非完全没有保存（not saved），属于程度上的错误。 选项D：错误。 对话中并未提到10号没有车可用，男士庆幸是因为他及时发现了车型需求，而非车辆 availability 的问题。
